verses.text: नृशंस पापभूयिष्ठ क्षुद्रकर्मसहायवान् । पापैः सहायैः संहत्य पापं कर्म चिकीर्षसि ॥

compounds.vigraha: क्षुद्रं कर्म येषां ते (बहुव्रीहि) सहायाः, ते अस्य सन्ति (मतुप्)

verses.english: O cruel one, most sinful, having helpers of base deeds: having joined with sinful helpers, you wish to do a sinful deed.
verses.gold_issues: सहायवान् is nominative between two vocatives; probably meant as the vocative सहायवन्, here taken as qualifying the unexpressed subject "you" (विशेषण > verb).

verses.text: वायुना चाहृतां दिव्यां सभां ते यदुपुंगवाः । बुभुजुः सर्वरत्नाढ्यां गोविन्दभुजसंश्रयात् ॥
verses.english: And those bulls among the Yadus, by virtue of resting on Govinda's arms, enjoyed the divine hall brought by Vāyu, rich in all jewels.
verses.gold_issues: संश्रयात् = ablative of cause (अपादान). वायुना = agent of the passive participle आहृताम्.

verses.text: एष ते कथितः सौम्य सद्भावस्त्वयि यो मम । यथा न मम पुत्रस्त्वं न पुत्रः शम्बरस्य च ॥
verses.english: O gentle one, this true feeling of mine towards you has been told to you: namely that you are not my son, nor the son of Śambara.
verses.gold_issues: verbless relative clause यो मम (त्वयि) folded into the noun: यः विशेषण>सद्भावः. The यथा-clause is verbless, headed by its subject त्वम>कथितः (it states what was told). ते tagged Dat (could equally be Gen).

verses.text: स्वर्गे शक्रानुयातेषु देवतूर्यनिनादिषु । सुन्दर्यः परिनृत्यन्ति शतशोऽप्सरसां गणाः ॥
verses.english: In heaven, in those [places/vehicles] attended by Śakra and resounding with the gods' music, beautiful troops of Apsarases dance about by the hundreds.
verses.gold_issues: the masc. loc. pl. शक्रानुयातेषु, देवतूर्यनिनादिषु qualify a noun not in the verse (e.g. विमानेषु of the context); headed to the verb as qualifiers of an unexpressed word. सुन्दर्यः (fem.) agrees in sense with अप्सरसाम्, not formally with गणाः.

verses.text: उपेन्द्राम्भोजगर्भेन्द्रयमाम्बुधनदेश्वराः । तथान्ये च शिवं स्थाप्य लिङ्गमूर्तिं महेश्वरम् ॥

compounds.vigraha: उपेन्द्रः च अम्भोजगर्भः च इन्द्रः च यमः च अम्ब्वीश्वरः च धनदेश्वरः च

verses.english: Upendra, the Lotus-born, Indra, Yama, the lord of waters and the lord of wealth, and likewise others, having installed Śiva, the great lord, in the form of the liṅga, ...
verses.gold_issues: no finite verb in the verse (it continues in the next); the absolutive स्थाप्य taken as root. The compound's last member ईश्वर is read with both अम्बु and धनद (Varuṇa, Kubera).

verses.text: जरायुधो व्याधिविकीर्णसायको यदान्तको व्याध इवाशिवः स्थितः । प्रजामृगान्भाग्यवनाश्रितांस्तुदन्वयःप्रकर्षं प्रति को मनोरथः ॥
verses.english: When Death stands like an inauspicious hunter, with old age as his weapon and diseases as his scattered arrows, striking down the deer that are creatures sheltering in the forest of fortune, what hope can there be of a long life?
verses.gold_issues: gold splits भाग्यवनाश्रितान् as भाग्यवन् (ADJ Voc "O fortunate one") + आश्रितान्; it is the compound भाग्य-वन-आश्रितान् "sheltering in the forest of fate" (treated as compound 13,14). प्रति governs वयःप्रकर्षम्, which is headed to मनोरथः. The यदा-clause verb स्थितः is headed to the verbless main clause (को मनोरथः, subject as root).

verses.text: एहि वक्ष्यामि रहसीत्युक्त्वा सो ऽभ्यन्तरं रहः । तया सह ययौ राजा परिवाराभिनन्दितः ॥
verses.english: Having said "Come, I will tell [you] in private", the king, greeted by his retinue, went with her into the inner private room.
verses.gold_issues: the quoted clauses are headed to the absolutive उक्त्वा.

verses.text: भीष्म उवाच । अत्राप्युदाहरन्तीममितिहासं पुरातनम् । मनोः प्रजापतेर्वादं महर्षेश्च बृहस्पतेः ॥
verses.english: Bhīṣma said: Here too they relate this ancient story, the dialogue of Manu Prajāpati and the great sage Bṛhaspati.
verses.gold_issues: वादम् is in apposition to इतिहासम्.

verses.text: अतिथिरुवाच । उपदेशं तु ते विप्र करिष्ये ऽहं यथागमम् । गुरुणा मे यथाख्यातमर्थतस्तच्च मे शृणु ॥
verses.english: The guest said: O brahmin, I shall give you instruction according to the tradition; hear from me, in its true sense, what was explained to me by my teacher.
verses.gold_issues: the text reads अर्थतः (adverb "according to the meaning"), gold has the form अर्थात् (NOUN Abl); annotated as the adverb. यथागमम् is an avyayībhāva adverb, gold tags ADJ Acc. Gold forms मम (10, 16) stand for text मे; 10 taken as the recipient of आख्यातम्, 16 as the source of शृणु. The यथा-clause verb is headed to its correlative तत्.

verses.text: ततो नित्योदिताख्यस्य प्रतीहाराधिकारिणः । इत्यकापरसंज्ञस्य पुत्रो ऽजायत गोमुखः ॥
verses.english: Then to Nityodita, holder of the office of chamberlain, whose other name was Ityaka, a son was born, Gomukha.
verses.gold_issues: gold splits इत्यकापरसंज्ञस्य as इति + अकापर + संज्ञस्य; it is इत्यक (a name) + अपर + संज्ञस्य "whose other name was Ityaka" (treated as one bahuvrīhi 5,6,7; इति is not a particle here).

verses.text: ततः शब्दादभिज्ञाय स व्याघ्रेण हन्तव्यः । ततस्तथानुष्ठिते सति तद्वृत्तम् । तथा चोक्तम् । छिद्रं मर्म च वीर्यं च सर्वं वेत्ति निजो रिपुः । दहत्यन्तर्गतश्चैव शुष्कं वृक्षमिवानलः ॥
verses.english: "Then, recognising him by his cry, he must be killed by the tiger." Then, when it had been done so, that came to pass. And so it is said: An enemy of one's own knows everything, one's weak spots, vital points and strength; and having got inside, he burns [one], just as fire [burns] a dry tree.
verses.gold_issues: prose plus verse; four sentences, each with its own root; the quoted verse is headed to उक्तम्. Locative absolute अनुष्ठिते सति: सति (अधिकरण) heads the absolute, अनुष्ठिते its predicate. सर्वम् sums up the list of objects, all marked कर्म.

verses.text: ततो देवा न्यवर्तन्त विज्वरा मुदिताश्च ते । न्यस्तशस्त्रेषु दैत्येषु विनिवृत्तास्तदा सुराः ॥
verses.english: Then those gods turned back, free of fever and delighted; when the Daityas had laid down their weapons, the gods then withdrew.
verses.gold_issues: locative absolute न्यस्तशस्त्रेषु दैत्येषु, with the bahuvrīhi as its predicate. विनिवृत्ताः = कर्तरि क्त predicate.

verses.text: कृतकृत्यो यथाकामं पूजयित्वा जनार्दनम् । ददर्शात्रिं मुनिं राजा प्रत्यक्षं तपसां निधिम् ॥
verses.english: Having worshipped Janārdana to his heart's content, the king, his purpose fulfilled, saw the sage Atri, the treasure-house of austerities, in person.
verses.gold_issues: यथाकामम् is an avyayībhāva adverb (gold ADJ Acc). कृतकृत्यः is an unsplit bahuvrīhi.

verses.text: तव भृत्यैस्तदा लुप्तं पापं चक्रुस्त्वदाज्ञया । हरेः कीर्तिं विना चान्यद्ब्राह्मणेन नृपोत्तम ॥
verses.english: O best of kings, then everything other than the praise of Hari was destroyed by your servants and by the brahmin; they committed sin at your command.
verses.gold_issues: uncertain verse (context missing). Gold tags लुप्तम् Acc (with पापम्); read here as Nom neuter predicate agreeing with अन्यत्, since the instrumentals भृत्यैः, ब्राह्मणेन need a passive verb. Gold form ते stands for text तव.

verses.text: स राज्ये स्थापितस्तेन सुग्रीवो वानरेश्वरः । राजा वानरमुख्यानां येन प्रस्थापिता वयम् ॥
verses.english: That Sugrīva, lord of the monkeys, king of the monkey chiefs, by whom we were sent out, was installed in the kingship by him.
verses.gold_issues: passive participles: सुग्रीवः and वयम् are nominative objects (कर्म). Relative clause येन … प्रस्थापिताः headed to correlative सः.

verses.text: हस्ते च तस्य तद्दृष्ट्वा सदैवाम्लानमम्बुजम् । अत्र केचिद्वणिक्पुत्राश्चत्वारो विस्मयं ययुः ॥
verses.english: And having seen in his hand that lotus, ever unwithered, four merchants' sons here were filled with wonder.
verses.gold_issues: अ of अम्लानम् split as PART (treated as nañ-compound 7,8). Gold form चत्वारर् should be चत्वारस्.

verses.text: कैकेय्याः प्रियकामार्थं पितुर्दशरथस्य च । हित्वा राज्यं च भोगांश्च प्रविष्टो दण्डकावनम् ॥
verses.english: To fulfil the wish of pleasing Kaikeyī and his father Daśaratha, he gave up the kingdom and its pleasures and entered the Daṇḍaka forest.
verses.gold_issues: -अर्थम् adverbial (अव्यय > verb); the genitives depend on the compound member प्रिय. प्रविष्टः = कर्तरि क्त predicate, subject (Rāma) unexpressed.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच । पूर्वं कृतयुगे राजन्नैमिषेयास्तपस्विनः । वर्तमाने सुबहुले सत्रे द्वादशवार्षिके । ऋषयो बहवो राजंस्तत्र सम्प्रतिपेदिरे ॥
verses.english: Vaiśampāyana said: Long ago, in the Kṛta age, O king, while the great twelve-year sacrificial session was going on, the ascetics of Naimiṣa, many seers, O king, assembled there.
verses.gold_issues: नैमिषेयास्तपस्विनः has no verb of its own; taken as in apposition to ऋषयः बहवः. सु split as ADV (compound 9,10). Gold form सत्त्रे, text सत्रे. Locative absolute वर्तमाने सत्रे.

verses.text: सुदुष्करं वहन्योगं कृशो धमनिसंततः । त्वगस्थिभूतो धर्मात्मा स पपातेति नः श्रुतम् ॥
verses.english: Practising the most difficult yoga, emaciated, his veins standing out, reduced to skin and bone, that righteous man fell down: so we have heard.
verses.gold_issues: नः = genitive agent of श्रुतम् (सम्बन्ध). सु split as ADV (compound 0,1). धमनिसंततः is an unsplit compound.

verses.text: अयं च मे महाभाग कुक्षावेव बृहस्पते । औतथ्यो वेदमत्रैव षडङ्गं प्रत्यधीयत ॥
verses.english: O illustrious Bṛhaspati, this Autathya, while still in my womb, learned the Veda with its six limbs right here.
verses.gold_issues: प्रत्यधीयत is the imperfect middle of प्रति+अधि+इ ("studied"); gold lemma प्रतिधा and Voice=Pass are wrong (active sense: औतथ्यः कर्ता, वेदम् कर्म). Gold form मम stands for text मे. षडङ्गम् tagged Neut; as a qualifier of वेदम् it should be Masc.

verses.text: अहं सर्वाणि सत्त्वानि दैवतान्यखिलानि तु । भुजंगानामहं शेषस्तार्क्ष्यो वै सर्वपक्षिणाम् ॥
verses.english: I am all beings and all the deities; among serpents I am Śeṣa, and among all birds Tārkṣya.
verses.gold_issues: two verbless clauses; the genitives are partitive (निर्धारण), marked सम्बन्ध.

verses.text: तमापतन्तं सम्प्रेक्ष्य केतुवर्माणमाहवे । अभ्यघ्नन्निशितैर्बाणैर्बीभत्सुः परवीरहा ॥
verses.english: Seeing that Ketuvarman rushing at him in battle, Bībhatsu, slayer of enemy heroes, struck [him] with sharpened arrows.
verses.gold_issues: निशितैः lemma should be नि+शा/शो ("sharpened"), not निशा.

verses.text: यद्वेष्टितशिरा भुङ्क्ते यद्भुङ्क्ते दक्षिणामुखः । सोपानत्कश्च यद्भुङ्क्ते सर्वं विद्यात्तदासुरम् ॥
verses.english: What one eats with the head covered, what one eats facing south, and what one eats wearing shoes — all that one should know to be demonic.
verses.gold_issues: three relative clauses headed to the correlative तत्; their unexpressed subject's qualifiers are headed to the verbs. स of सोपानत्कः split as ADV (compound 8,9). आसुरम् is an object complement (विधेय > तत्).

verses.text: तस्मिंस्तत्परमं ध्यानं ध्यायतो ब्रह्मणस्तदा । उत्पन्नस्तु शिखायुक्तः कुमारः श्वेतलोहितः ॥
verses.english: Then, in that [aeon], while Brahmā was meditating that supreme meditation, there arose a boy with a topknot, white and red.
verses.gold_issues: genitive absolute ध्यायतो ब्रह्मणः (subject सम्बन्ध>participle, participle सम्बन्ध>verb). तस्मिन् refers to a masculine noun of the context (कल्पे). Gold form ब्रह्मनस् should be ब्रह्मणस्.

verses.text: प्रतिगृह्णामि ते वाचं सत्यामेतां जनार्दन । अमित्रान्मे महाबाहो सानुबन्धान्हनिष्यसि ॥
verses.english: I accept this true word of yours, Janārdana: O mighty-armed one, you will slay my enemies together with their followers.
verses.gold_issues: सत्याम् could also be an object complement ("accept as true"). Gold form मम (7) stands for text मे.

verses.text: अग्रन्यस्तविषाणाग्रः कृष्णकुक्षिकृतेक्षणः । अभ्यधावत दुष्टात्मा कृष्णं वृषभदानवः ॥

compounds.vigraha: अग्रे न्यस्तानि विषाणयोः अग्राणि येन सः
कृष्णस्य कुक्षौ कृतम् ईक्षणं येन सः

verses.english: The evil-souled bull-demon, the tips of his horns lowered in front, his gaze fixed on Kṛṣṇa's belly, charged at Kṛṣṇa.

verses.text: आश्चर्यं तत्र राजेन्द्र सुमहद्दृष्टवानहम् । न मोघः सायकः कश्चित्सात्यकेरभवत्प्रभो ॥
verses.english: There, O king of kings, I saw a very great wonder: not a single arrow of Sātyaki was in vain, my lord.
verses.gold_issues: gold form दृष्टवन् should be दृष्टवान्. सु split as ADV (compound 4,5).

verses.text: देवासुरक्षयकराः प्रजानां तु हिताय वै । हिरण्यकशिपू राजा वर्षाणामर्बुदं बभौ ॥

compounds.vigraha: देवानाम् असुराणां च (द्वन्द्व) क्षयं कुर्वन्ति इति

verses.english: ... causing the destruction of gods and asuras, but for the welfare of creatures; King Hiraṇyakaśipu shone [in power] for an arbuda of years.
verses.gold_issues: देवासुरक्षयकराः (masc. nom. pl.) cannot agree with the singular subject; it continues a noun of the previous verse and is headed to the verb only as a placeholder. वर्षाणाम् अर्बुदम् = accusative of duration (कर्म, as the reference does for रात्रिम्).

verses.text: ज्ञातीनां हि मिथो भेदे यन्मित्रं नाभिपद्यते । सर्वयत्नेन मध्यस्थं न तन्मित्रं विदुर्बुधाः ॥
verses.english: For when kinsmen are divided among themselves, the friend who does not with all effort take the part of mediator, the wise do not regard that as a friend.
verses.gold_issues: यत् is the relative pronoun (Nom Neut) agreeing with मित्रम्, not SCONJ; मित्रम् (5) is the Nom Neut subject of अभिपद्यते, not Masc Acc. मध्यस्थम् taken as the object of अभिपद्यते ("takes on the role of mediator").

verses.text: मथुरां च पुनः प्राप्तावुग्रसेनेन पालिताम् । प्रहृष्टपुरुषस्त्रीकावुभौ रामजनार्दनौ ॥

compounds.vigraha: प्रहृष्टाः पुरुषाः स्त्रियः च (द्वन्द्व) ययोः तौ

verses.english: And both Rāma and Janārdana, [surrounded by] delighted men and women, came again to Mathurā, protected by Ugrasena.
verses.gold_issues: प्राप्तौ = कर्तरि क्त predicate with accusative goal.

verses.text: समीक्ष्य तं संयति चित्रकार्मुकं महाबलं वासवतुल्यविक्रमम् । सलक्ष्मणं को विषहेत राघवं हुताशनं दीप्तमिवानिलेरितम् ॥
verses.english: Having seen him in battle — with his wondrous bow, of great strength, of valour equal to Vāsava's — who could withstand Rāghava with Lakṣmaṇa, like a blazing fire fanned by the wind?
verses.gold_issues: the object of the absolutive is the same Rāghava (shared object, headed to the main verb). Text संयति, gold form संयत्याम्. स of सलक्ष्मणम् split as ADV (compound 10,11).

verses.text: स चागत्य वणिग्यावत्सभृत्यः पाशबन्धनम् । डोम्बमेव तमद्राक्षीन्न तु सिद्धिकरीं क्वचित् ॥
verses.english: And when that merchant came with his servants, he saw only that Ḍomba bound with a noose, but nowhere [the woman] Siddhikarī.
verses.gold_issues: यावत् = "when, as soon as" with the absolutive (KSS idiom), not a subordinating conjunction with a finite verb. न … सिद्धिकरीम् shares the verb अद्राक्षीत्. स of सभृत्यः split as ADV (compound 5,6).

verses.text: न हि कामात्मना राज्ञा सततं शठबुद्धिना । नृशंसेनातिलुब्धेन शक्याः पालयितुं प्रजाः ॥
verses.english: For subjects cannot be protected by a king who is lustful, ever crooked-minded, cruel and excessively greedy.
verses.gold_issues: शक्याः + infinitive in passive sense: प्रजाः nominative object (कर्म), राज्ञा agent (कर्ता). Gold form नृशंसेण should be नृशंसेन. अति split as ADP (compound 9,10).

verses.text: दुःखं न मे स्यात्सुखमेव मे स्यादिति प्रवृत्तः सततं हि लोकः । न वेत्ति तच्चैव तथा यथा स्यात्प्राप्तं त्वयाद्यासुलभं यथावत् ॥
verses.english: For the world is constantly busy with the thought "May I have no sorrow, may I have only happiness"; yet it does not know that [happiness] in the way in which you today have duly attained what is hard to attain.
verses.gold_issues: genuinely ambiguous second line: स्यात् प्राप्तम् read as a periphrastic predicate of असुलभम् in the यथा-clause, headed to the correlative तथा; alternatively "how it may be obtained". The quoted wish-clauses are headed to प्रवृत्तः.

verses.text: न मे जानाति सत्त्वं वा प्रभावं वासितेक्षणा । तस्मात्पश्यतु वैदेही यद्रूपं मम कामतः ॥
verses.english: The dark-eyed one does not know my strength or my power; therefore let Vaidehī see the form that is mine at will.
verses.gold_issues: the verbless relative clause यद्रूपं मम कामतः stands for the object of पश्यतु (implicit correlative तत्); रूपम् tagged Nom, used here as object. Gold form मम (1) stands for text मे.

verses.text: मा भैर्वत्स न भेतव्यमिहैवायाहि मेऽन्तिकम् । मार्कण्डेयो मुनिस्त्वाह बालं तं श्रमपीडितः ॥
verses.english: "Do not be afraid, child, there is nothing to fear; come here, close to me" — so said the sage Mārkaṇḍeya, worn out with fatigue, to that child.
verses.gold_issues: annotated as written (Mārkaṇḍeya nominative, the child accusative), although in the story the child addresses Mārkaṇḍeya; the text may be corrupt. भेतव्यम् = impersonal gerundive (क्रिया). Gold form मम (8) stands for text मे.

verses.text: तस्मिन्हि यात्रा लोकस्य भूतानामीश्वरो हि सः । तस्मिन्धृतिश्च वीर्यं च प्रज्ञा चौजश्च माधवे ॥
verses.english: For on him rests the course of the world; he indeed is the lord of beings; in him, in Mādhava, are steadfastness and valour, wisdom and vigour.
verses.gold_issues: three verbless clauses; existential locatives marked अधिकरण > subject. Coordinated subjects of the last clause headed to the first conjunct धृतिः.

verses.text: सासुराः सहगन्धर्वाः सनागनरदेवताः । विदिताः सर्वलोकास्ते ससागरधराधराः ॥

compounds.vigraha: नागैः नरैः देवताभिः च सह वर्तमानाः

verses.english: All the worlds, with their asuras, gandharvas, nāgas, men and gods, with their oceans and mountains, are known to you.
verses.gold_issues: स / सह prefixes split as ADV (bahuvrīhis 0-1, 2-3, 4-7, 12-14). ते = "to/by you", genitive agent of विदिताः (क्तस्य च वर्तमाने), marked सम्बन्ध; gold tags Dat. ते could also be तद् "those worlds". देवता tagged Masc (bahuvrīhi).

verses.text: हन्त लक्ष्मण पश्येह सुमित्रा सुप्रजास्त्वया । भीमस्तनितगम्भीरस्तुमुलः श्रूयते स्वनः ॥
verses.english: Ah, Lakṣmaṇa, look here: in you Sumitrā has a good son! A tumultuous sound, deep as fearful thunder, is heard.
verses.gold_issues: the verbless clause सुमित्रा सुप्रजाः त्वया (object content of पश्य) is headed by its subject to पश्य. स्वनः = nominative of the passive श्रूयते (कर्म).

verses.text: तयोरासीत्सम्प्रहारः क्रुद्धयोर्भीमरक्षसोः । अमृष्यमाणयोः संख्ये देवदानवयोरिव ॥
verses.english: In the battle there was a clash between those two, Bhīma and the rākṣasa, enraged and unyielding, like that between a god and a dānava.
verses.gold_issues: अमृष्यमाणयोः tagged Loc; it is Gen dual agreeing with भीमरक्षसोः.
